title: RemotiveTopology Cloud Launcher
description: Describes how to launch a RemotiveTopology instance in the cloud. Lives at the root of a launcher archive as <name>.launcher.yaml, where <name> is the topology project directory name. All paths are relative to the topology project root, i.e. the directory the archive is extracted into.

schema.description: The JSON schema version of this launcher descriptor.

topology_instances.description: Instance files passed to `remotive topology build` as -f flags, in the order listed. Later files override earlier ones.

compose_overlays.description: Extra `docker compose -f` overlay files applied on top of the generated docker-compose.yml, in the order listed. Empty when the topology needs no overlays.

compose_profiles.description: `docker compose --profile` values enabled for the long-running stack. Do NOT list the test profile here: the launcher runs `test_service` separately so its exit code gives the pass/fail verdict.

test_service.description: Compose service run with `docker compose run <test_service>` when the launcher is asked to run topology tests (runTopologyTests=true). Its exit code is the test verdict. The service is expected to sit behind a compose profile of the same name that is not part of `compose_profiles`.

forward_ports.description: Topology ports reachable during the keep-alive window.

adb_devices.description: Android devices (e.g. Cuttlefish virtual devices) exposed by the topology that the launcher should connect to with `adb connect` on the given port, presented under the given name.

relative_path.description: A path relative to the topology project root. Must not be absolute and must not escape the project root.

yaml_path.description: A relative path to a YAML file.

instance_path.description: A relative path to a RemotiveTopology instance file (*.instance.yaml).

compose_name.description: A docker compose service or profile name.

named_port.description: A TCP port on the topology host, labelled with a human-readable name. Both fields are required.

name.description: Display name used when exposing the port, e.g. as the tunnel name or the adb device label.
